description: DriveNets is a leader in disaggregated high-scale networking solutions for service providers and AI infrastructures. DriveNets’ Network Cloud offers a radical new way to build networks, accelerating deployment and improving the network’s economic model. A software-based solution, DriveNets’ Network Cloud runs on standard white boxes, adapting the architectural model of the cloud to telco-grade networking, radically simplifying the network’s operations. DriveNets’ Network Cloud-AI solution, based on the same technology, was introduced to the market in 2023, providing the highest-performance Ethernet-based AI networking solution. It is deployed by hyperscalers, neoclouds and enterprises.
tagline: A radical new way to build networks

description: Via was founded in 2012 and has grown into the world’s leading developer of public mobility systems, defining the TransitTech category. We partner with cities and transit agencies across the globe, harnessing the power of data to optimize networks of buses, shuttles, wheelchair accessible vehicles (WAVs), school buses, autonomous vehicles, electric vehicles, and more. Our modular system has been proven in urban, suburban, and rural geographies and is specifically designed to serve everyone, everywhere, including those with limited mobility, those without access to smartphones, and the unbanked. With our public sector partners, we work to lower the costs of public transit provision and to provide transit options that compete with the convenience of personal cars. Together with our partners, we work to make mobility more accessible, equitable, and sustainable. Alone in our industry, Via is able to combine its expertise as an integrator of all elements of a public transit system with the technological innovation of a software leader and the service design capabilities of a world-class transit planning consultancy. To date, Via has partnered with over hundreds of public transit providers globally, and the company’s technology has powered over 130 million rides in services around the world.
tagline: Powering public mobility

description: AppsFlyer helps brands make good choices for their business and their customers with its advanced measurement, data analytics, deep linking, engagement, fraud protection, data clean room, and privacy preserving technologies. Built on the idea that brands can increase customer privacy while providing exceptional experiences, AppsFlyer empowers thousands of creators and technology partners to create better, more meaningful customer relationships.
tagline: Data-powered marketing measurement platform

description: Selected by TIME Magazine as one of the Top 100 Most Influential Companies in the World, Tomorrow.io is the world's leading Resilience Platform™. Combining next-generation space technology, advanced generative AI, and proprietary weather modeling, Tomorrow.io delivers unmatched forecasting and decision-making capabilities. Trusted by six of the top ten Fortune 500 companies, Tomorrow.io empowers organizations to proactively manage weather-related risks and opportunities, while improving operational efficiency. From cutting-edge weather intelligence to real-time early warning systems, Tomorrow.io enables predictive, impact-based action for a safer, more resilient future. Learn more at Tomorrow.io.
tagline: The world's leading Resilience Platform™

description: Riskified uses the latest technology and an innovative approach to improve eCommerce for merchants and shoppers. The world’s largest brands, from airlines to luxury fashion houses to gift card marketplaces, trust us to increase revenue, manage risk, and enhance their customer experience. Merchants lose billions of dollars to legacy fraud solutions, payment failures, high-friction verification methods, and more. Riskified uses powerful machine-learning algorithms to recognize legitimate customers and help them complete their purchase. And then we guarantee that income. Merchants can safely approve more orders, expand internationally, and fulfill omnichannel flows while providing a frictionless customer experience. Shoppers benefit from a smoother checkout experience, fewer incorrectly declined orders, and alternative payment options.
tagline: eCommerce optimization solutions

description: Bringing fault-tolerant quantum computing to light. Quantum Source is developing scalable photonic architectures to enable practical, cost-effective quantum computers.
tagline: Bringing quantum computing to light

description: AAl is a team of elite researchers spanning computer science, mathematics, physics, and biology. We are building transformative Al technology that drives new scientific discoveries and reshapes how humanity solves its hardest problems. Our mission is simple: to usher in a new age of discovery by cracking the code of superintelligence.
tagline: Solving humanity’s biggest challenges in CS, math and science.

description: Catch is an AI admin assistant built for business leaders. Catch handles scheduling, travel, email and day-to-day admin autonomously, onboarding in minutes with no prompting, fine-tuning or workflow building, and involving the executive only when judgment is needed.
tagline: AI assistant autonomously handling executives’ daily administrative tasks.

description: GammaTime is a short-form streaming platform delivering premium, mobile-first entertainment designed for today’s viewing habits. The platform offers a growing library of original and exclusive series across drama, romance, true crime, and other popular genres, including collaborations with established entertainment brands. Available across web, iOS, and Android, GammaTime combines bite-sized storytelling with an on-demand streaming experience, making high-quality entertainment easy to discover and watch anytime, anywhere.
tagline: Short-form streaming platform for premium vertical entertainment.

description: Driven by the success of its students, Masterschool is a global network of career-training schools led by industry experts and companies. Masterschool has developed a proven process to train talented individuals for careers in tech, allowing students to focus on their studies and pay no tuition until they are hired.
tagline: Global network of success-based professional schools

description: Finout is the enterprise-grade FinOps platform transforming cloud costs into business insights. With patented MegaBill and Instant Virtual Tags, Finout delivers real-time, code-agnostic cost allocation across cloud providers, SaaS, and AI services. DevOps and FinOps teams gain immediate visibility without relying on complex tagging, enabling precise, actionable reporting. From high-level dashboards to detailed unit economics, Finout empowers organizations with full financial accountability and control. Built to scale, Finout bridges the gap between engineering speed and financial governance, helping businesses align innovation with cost efficiency, making every dollar in the cloud accountable.
tagline: Enterprise-grade FinOps platform

description: Frontegg offers the first SaaS-as-a-Service platform, consisting of pre-built, essential, and easily integrated SaaS product capabilities. It empowers dev and engineering teams to quickly build and modernize existing and new SaaS applications to meet today’s high standards for user experience, security, and performance.
tagline: Platform for fast-tracking SaaS development and innovation

description: QuantHealth is an AI company conducting patient-centric drug simulations to accelerate and de-risk drug development. Over 90% of drugs in clinical development fail to reach the market, which results in over $45B per year in direct losses to the pharma and biotech industry. Our platform allows our pharma and biotech partners to rapidly run thousands of variations of their clinical trials to optimize the trial design and significantly increase the probability of trial success, all while enabling discovery of new clinical opportunities and optimization strategies. QuantHealth has one the largest integrated datasets that spans the clinical, pharmacological, and biological domains, together with a proprietary AI platform that can predict patient response to both approved and novel therapies.
tagline: Advancing drug development through deep clinical simulations

description: Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale. Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600 million daily active users across some of the top publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi, and more use Taboola’s technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.
tagline: Taboola (Nasdaq: TBLA) is a global leader in delivering performance at scale for advertisers.

description: Variantyx is a molecular diagnostics company providing genetic testing for rare genetic disorders, reproductive genetics, and precision oncology – disrupting the traditional testing approach with its advanced proprietary whole-genome technology.
tagline: Precision diagnostics using whole-genome analysis

description: Quantum computing promises to be one of the most world-changing technologies ever developed, with applications across climate, energy, healthcare, industry, and government. PsiQuantum was founded on the premise that a useful quantum computer requires fault tolerance and error correction — and therefore roughly one million physical qubits. While many approaches can produce small numbers of qubits, PsiQuantum’s photonic architecture offers significant advantages at the scale required for error correction. By leveraging advanced semiconductor manufacturing in partnership with GlobalFoundries, PsiQuantum is working to deliver a practical, commercially relevant quantum computer.
tagline: Building the world’s first useful, fault-tolerant, error-corrected quantum computer

description: Vertos Medical is committed to developing innovative, minimally invasive treatments for lumbar spinal stenosis (LSS). Its proprietary technologies include mild ®, a quick outpatient procedure that helps LSS patients achieve lasting relief from back pain and improved mobility. This minimally invasive, low-risk treatment option requires no general anesthesia, implants, or stitches, and has been performed on more than 30,000 patients. Clinical data from a one-year study at Cleveland Clinic shows that mild® can help many LSS patients stand longer and walk farther with less pain. The procedure is cleared by the FDA and nationally covered by all Medicare plan types.
tagline: Minimally invasive spinal treatment devices

description: Formlabs is expanding access to digital fabrication so anyone can make anything. Headquartered in Somerville, Massachusetts, with offices in Germany, Japan, China, Singapore, Hungary, and North Carolina, Formlabs is the professional 3D printer of choice for engineers, designers, manufacturers, and decision makers around the globe. Formlabs products include the Form 3, Form 3B, and Form 3L, powered by an advanced form of stereolithography (SLA) called Low Force Stereolithography (LFS)™ 3D printing, as well as the Form Wash and Form Cure post-processing solutions, Fuse 1 SLS 3D printer, and Form Cell manufacturing solution. Formlabs also develops its own suite of high-performance materials that continue to push the boundaries for 3D printing, as well as best-in-class 3D printing software.
tagline: Professional 3D printer manufacturer powering modern digital fabrication

description: Komodor enables enterprises to unlock the full potential of Kubernetes at scale. Our pioneering Kubernetes Management Platform eliminates complexity across the entire Kubernetes stack, driving efficiency, empowering developers and optimizing cost and performance. With Komodor, every stakeholder – from Platform engineers and SREs to developers and data engineers – can leverage the value of Kubernetes to accelerate their business. Our mission is to simplify Kubernetes, so you can lower costs, accelerate development, and keep on innovating.
tagline: Komodor simplifies Kubernetes management at scale, from migration to day-to-day operations

description: Care teams are stretched thin, often forced to choose between quality and the demands of growing caseloads Laguna Health’s conversational AI companion boosts efficiency and care quality, empowering teams to deliver better care faster—while providing leaders real-time insights to make informed decisions and support better training and performance.
tagline: Conversational AI for care teams

description: Cellular Intelligence builds AI foundation models for human stem cells, reducing data costs 1,000-fold and delivering unprecedented predictive power to discover, refine, and scale novel cell therapies. Its full-stack platform spans novel data generation, large-scale model training, and application optimization. The founding team pairs repeat AI entrepreneur Micha Breakstone (Chorus.ai exit $575M) with the head of MIT’s Fundamental AI Group and three Harvard Medical School leaders, including the genetics chair. Based in Boston, Cellular Intelligence has raised ~$60M to date and launched operations in January 2024.
tagline: Foundation models for scalable stem cell therapies

description: Tailor Brands is a business builder that empowers and simplifies the journey of starting and running a small business. Its all-in-one platform connects all the tools needed to build a successful company and provides personalized guidance every step of the way. The platform combines everything entrepreneurs need to start, manage, and grow their business, from forming a legal entity to branding, operational management, and more. Tailor Brands offers a comprehensive suite of services designed to meet the diverse needs of small businesses.
tagline: Business-building platform that simplifies your business journey

description: Zerto enables enterprises to simplify modernization and cloud adoption by eliminating the risk and complexity of traditional recovery solutions. Its IT Resilience Platform unifies disaster recovery, backup, and cloud mobility in one converged software solution. Built for enterprise scale, Zerto delivers continuous availability and makes it easy to protect, recover, and move applications across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
tagline: All-in-one IT resilience platform

description: The Elevate™ percutaneous Left Ventricular Assist Device (pLVAD) is a self-expanding, percutaneous heart pump designed to provide temporary mechanical circulatory support for the left ventricle (LV) during high-risk percutaneous coronary interventions (HR-PCI) and in patients with cardiogenic shock (CS). The Elevate™ pump is delivered sheathed into the LV through commercially available 10 Fr femoral introducer sheaths, fully over-the-wire (0.018”). Once positioned in the LV, the pump is unsheathed and expands from 9 Fr to 30 Fr. The Elevate™ System has been successfully evaluated in First-in-Human and U.S. Early Feasibility (EFS) studies in HR-PCI patients, and a U.S. HR-PCI pivotal study comparing Elevate™ with Impella is planned to launch.
tagline: Novel solution for heart failure patients

description: Tulip Interfaces (Tulip), the leader in frontline operations, helps companies equip their workforce with AI-enabled, connected apps — improving quality, efficiency, and end-to-end traceability across operations. With Tulip’s cloud-based platform, teams closest to the work can use composability and edge connectivity to digitize processes, guide operators, track production, and gain a real-time, holistic view of operations. A spinoff from MIT, Tulip is headquartered in Boston, MA, with offices in Germany and Singapore.
tagline: Leader in composable frontline operations

description: AI21 Labs was founded by AI luminaries and veterans of the elite technology unit of Israel’s IDF to build artificial intelligence systems with an unprecedented capacity to understand and generate natural language. The company is redefining how people read and write today, making everyday interaction with text an AI-first experience.
tagline: AI for the 21st century

description: Leaba Semiconductor developed high-performance silicon solutions that connected memory, storage, and compute systems in data center environments, improving efficiency and throughput for modern workloads. The company was acquired by Cisco Systems.
tagline: Data center silicon connectivity solutions, acquired by Cisco Systems

description: Varonis provides a software platform that helps enterprises map, analyze, manage, and secure their unstructured, human-generated data. This includes documents, presentations, media files, emails, messages, and other content created by employees that often contains sensitive financial information, product plans, intellectual property, and strategic data. Organizations use Varonis for data governance, security, archiving, file synchronization, mobile accessibility, and collaboration.
tagline: Went public on NASDAQ

description: Silos can sneak into even the most agile teams and create needless delays on essential projects. Chasing down information keeps teams out of sync, but onboarding, outdated documents, or project switching should never slow a project down. Swimm is a SaaS company built to make the development process fast and smooth by creating frictionless learning paths and continuous documentation. Teams use Swimm to create focused and engaging tutorials that help them share knowledge of the codebase. Thanks to Swimm's unique auto-sync technology, tutorials remain fresh and up-to-date even if the code changes.
tagline: Sync development teams with their code

description: Optibus is a unified software platform for public transportation planning, scheduling, operations, real-time control, and passenger information. Using artificial intelligence (AI) and optimization algorithms, Optibus helps transportation agencies and operators in thousands of cities across 35 countries design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transportation networks. That means fewer emissions and more electric buses, more reliable and accessible service for passengers, better work conditions for drivers, and improved operational efficiency and cost savings for clients. With the closing of its Series D in 2022, Optibus became the first unicorn dedicated to the public transportation sector.
tagline: Unified software for public transportation planning and operations

description: StreamElements is the end-to-end platform for live stream production, monetization, audience engagement, and brand partnerships. Offering a full stack of tech and business solutions, combined with legendary customer service, we support over 200k channels on Twitch and YouTube, reaching more than 15 million viewers watching over 12 billion minutes of content. In addition, brands, media and influencer agencies, talent agencies and management firms, eSports teams, and publishers all leverage StreamElements' tech and services to run global ad campaigns and livestream sponsorships.
tagline: Video content creation and monetization platform

description: Nexite turns real-time product engagement into actionable store intelligence. Instead of relying on sales reports that only show what happened or RFID systems that reveal what’s in stock, Nexite uncovers why items don’t sell. By tracking how every product is seen, picked, tried, or left behind, the platform identifies what’s blocking conversion and guides store teams with clear actions to fix it. The result is up to an 8% lift in full-price sales, stronger GMROI, and better execution, all without changes to existing workflows. Nexite doesn’t just show what sold; it shows why it didn’t, and what to do about it.
tagline: Nexite brings the online experience into physical stores

description: Nas.io is the fastest way to build a digital business using AI. In just one minute, anyone can turn their ideas into income by creating digital products, memberships, events, and more - all from one intuitive platform, no technical skills required. Nas.io puts community first. With AI-powered tools that analyze your social presence, recommend what to sell, and automate your marketing, we help entrepreneurs grow revenue while keeping human connection at the core. Backed by 200K+ users, Nas.io is building the future of business: personal, automated, and community-driven.
tagline: Community building platform for creators

description: Volumez innovates next generation cloud-native storage as a premier data infrastructure-as-a-service company that helps organizations realize the true potential of their data. With its patented controller-less architecture, Volumez tackles latency and scalability challenges by establishing direct Linux data paths, ensuring exceptional performance and resiliency with transformative economics. Through innovative technology and a customer-centric approach, Volumez offers comprehensive solutions that streamline data workflows, enhance data quality, and drive informed decision-making.
tagline: Next-gen cloud storage that's fast, scalable, resilient, and transformative

description: Restore Medical is a privately held Israeli clinical-stage company dedicated to transforming the treatment of heart failure through novel transcatheter therapies that aim to restore hemodynamic balance and improve clinical outcomes for patients worldwide. Up-to-date clinical data demonstrate promising long-term safety and efficacy including meaningful improvements in ventricular reverse remodeling, hemodynamic performance, and patient functional capacity. Restore Medical is led by CEO Gilad Marom and began its operations within Peregrine Ventures' Incentive Incubator after being Co-Founded by Stephen Bellomo (CTO), Dr. Elchanan Bruckheimer (Medical Director), and Aaron Feldman.
tagline: Clinical-stage MedTech company developing transcatheter therapies for heart failure

description: Guardoc is your AI-powered compliance nurse. It helps prevent litigation and fines, and gives you the insights you need to manage your workforce, all in one platform. Imagine having unlimited nurses catching every documentation error that could impact care, audits, PDPM reimbursement, or compliance. That's Guardoc.
tagline: AI clinical compliance nurse

description: Protai is a tech-bio drug discovery company based in Tel Aviv. Founded by tech entrepreneurs Eran Seger and Kirill Pevzner, Protai brings a technology-first approach to disrupt traditional biotech. At the core of Protai’s innovation is the AIMS™ platform, which maps protein complexes to accelerate the development of novel therapeutics for patients worldwide.
tagline: Proteomics and AI for drug discovery

description: Carefam is an AI-powered hiring platform built for healthcare. It streamlines the talent acquisition process by automating sourcing, screening, interview scheduling, and onboarding—enabling organizations to hire clinicians up to three times faster. The platform requires no IT integration and supports hiring across roles such as RNs, LPNs, and CNAs. With a focus on lasting placements (not temporary staffing), Carefam matches verified, pre-screened clinicians to top healthcare employers across the U.S.
tagline: AI-powered hiring platform connecting healthcare providers with clinicians

description: LeaFix developed the only transcatheter functional mitral valve regurgitation (FMR) repair solution, performed by an augmentation of the Mitral Valve anterior leaflet. The system is composed of an implant and a delivery system, used for implanting an implant into the valve anterior leaflet while expanding the implant within the leaflet, thereby enhancing the leaflet area and creating coaptation of the leaflets.
tagline: Transcatheter device augmenting the mitral valve for regurgitation repair

description: Oshi is a foodtech company developing a breakthrough additive manufacturing technology to produce premium whole-cut, plant-based fish fillets to sustainably feed the world at scale. Our vision is to become the world's leading seafood brand, all without hurting a single fish. Our first product is Oshi Salmon™, which is not only delicious, but also high in protein and Omega-3s, and free of mercury and antibiotics. Founded in March 2021 by serial entrepreneurs and a team of 3D printing, chemistry, and bioengineering PhDs, the company raised a $2M pre-seed round, followed by a $12.45M seed round from some of the world’s preeminent company builders.
tagline: Seafood fillets made from plants

description: ARMO pioneers a new approach to cloud security with an open-source-powered, behavioral driven, cloud-native threat detection and response solution. The ARMO CADR solution is the first to link suspicious behavior across the entire cloud stack to create a full attack chain story, instead of siloed alerts.
tagline: ARMO is pioneering cloud runtime security

description: Designed to be mobile from the ground up, the Tabit solution implements mobile best practices and offers a business-process oriented solution that serves both restaurant operators and their customers. Tabit is a cloud-based solution, deployed using the latest technologies and utilizing tablets and smartphones as the primary touchpoints, eliminating the need for traditional on-premise software installation and support. Built on a single unified platform, Tabit offers solutions that address the entire restaurant ecosystem, reducing the need for multiple integration points and breaking down legacy information silos. The solution is easy and fast to deploy. Tabit supports multiple touchpoints for both restaurant operators and customers, all leveraging the same business logic and uniﬁed database. Various stakeholders within the restaurant can benefit from these capabilities: servers, kitchen staff, managers, greeters, and even customers themselves.
tagline: 360 hospitality management platform

description: D-ID is the leading interface for the agentic AI revolution, pioneering Natural User Interfaces (NUI) with hyper-realistic, interactive avatars for AI agents, assistants, and co-pilots. With an enterprise-grade, secure, and scalable streaming API, D-ID enables seamless, human-like interactions that enhance trust and redefine AI-powered communication. Since its founding in 2017, D-ID has been supported by tier-1 VCs and has grown to over 100 employees globally. Over 180 million videos featuring digital humans have been created using D-ID’s self-service studio and integrations, while more than 280,000 developers are building innovative solutions with the D-ID API.
tagline: Powering hyper-realistic, interactive visual agents at scale

description: Teza is redefining communications for the modern age. We build AI platforms to help companies and leaders massively improve their reach and resonance. Our technology fuses prediction AI, behavioral modeling, and LLMs to transform how campaigns—whether for defense, geopolitics, or brand awareness—are designed and executed.
tagline: AI-powered communications firm

description: Revolutionizing commercial auto insurance with real-time AI, OpenEyes' cutting-edge technology prevents accidents and lowers premiums for buses and trucks. Offering advanced claims management and fleet safety, OpenEyes delivers safer operations and a more efficient insurance model. Founded by Yoav Oron, Dr. Omry Sendik, and Dan Charash, and led by insurance veteran Gary Flaherty.
tagline: Accident prevention and commercial auto insurance

description: Zorro is revolutionizing the US employee benefits market for employers and their teams. Through our state-of-the-art technology and user-centric approach, we leverage ICHRA regulation to offer a modern alternative to traditional coverage that restores budget predictability, plan flexibility, and employee choice.
tagline: Tech-forward, user-centric ICHRA administration platform

description: PayEm is a spend and payments automation platform built for growing small and mid-sized businesses. Instead of juggling spreadsheets and disconnected tools, finance teams can manage everything in one place—from issuing corporate cards to automating payments and staying on top of compliance. PayEm is designed to grow with your business, giving finance leaders real-time visibility and control without the complexity of enterprise systems. With easy ERP integrations, approval flows that actually fit your team, and support for multiple currencies, PayEm helps businesses move faster, stay organized, and confidently manage spend as they scale globally.
tagline: Automating global spend, payments, compliance, and finance operations

description: Mend.io offers the first AI-native application security platform, empowering organizations to build and run a proactive AppSec program tuned for AI-powered development. The unified platform secures AI-generated code and embedded AI components, drives risk reduction through AI-powered remediation, automates compliance, and provides a holistic enterprise-scale view of risks with clear actions for developers across the entire codebase. Learn more at www.mend.io
tagline: AI-native application security platform

description: Based in San Jose, CA, Visby Medical is a diagnostics company on a mission to change the way we test for infectious diseases. Visby Medical’s platform combines the gold-standard for disease testing technology with a handheld, disposable device. It puts the power of the lab in the palm of your hand.
tagline: Personal PCR that fits in the palm of your hand

description: The Lumen device and app help you take control of your metabolism. We help people achieve metabolic health by making better nutrition and lifestyle choices so they can enjoy a higher quality of life and live longer. Through your breath, Lumen measures your fuel source in real time, telling you if you're using fats or carbs for energy, and providing you with a personalized nutrition plan to help you reach your health and fitness goals. Lumen began with twin sisters Merav and Michal - two mothers, Ironman winners, and PhDs in physiology. As scientists and athletes, they were passionate about developing a way to provide personalized nutrition that was backed by science, but knew the only way to measure metabolism was costly and time consuming. Today, over 2 million measurements a month are made on the Lumen platform with a single breath.
tagline: Metabolism-tracking device powered by real-time breath analysis

description: Connie Health helps you live a healthier and happier life while spending less on healthcare. This is achieved by finding your optimal healthcare plan with the best doctors available, and by helping you navigate your plan’s benefits and the Medicare system. We achieve this by pairing technology with local Medicare expertise and personalized human interactions. Connie Health’s advanced technology simplifies the selection process with unbiased plan advice based on the doctors, medications, and benefits that are important to you and available in your community. All the while, a local licensed expert is available to answer your questions and guide you through the process to help make the right decision for yourself or your loved ones. Once enrolled in a plan, you have access to a local Medicare care team that can help you find doctors and specialists, and explain your plan benefits.
tagline: Technology platform improving how people choose and navigate healthcare

description: Aquant delivers Service Intelligence, giving service leaders, techs, and teams the insights they need for every situation. Aquant understands service data in context, transforming unstructured information into structured, actionable insights. This shifts service from simply fixing problems to creating new business value, and from putting out fires to driving customer satisfaction and lasting loyalty. Now, service leaders can reduce escalations, technicians can solve tough issues, and teams can make service feel effortless.
tagline: AI-powered service intelligence platform

description: Incredo® Sugar is the flagship product of Incredo LTD (formerly DouxMatok), a global food-tech company pioneering the development of efficient nutrition and flavor technologies that enable healthier food consumption. Incredo® Sugar is a first-of-its-kind, sugar-based sugar reduction solution. Made from real cane and beet sugar, Incredo® Sugar provides between 30%-50% sugar reduction in food and snacks, with no compromise on taste or sweetness.
tagline: Sugar reduction solution

description: Logz.io is the leading cloud-native observability platform that enables engineers to use the best open-source tools on the market without the complexity of operating, managing, and scaling them. Logz.io offers four products: Log Management built on ELK, Infrastructure Monitoring based on open-source Grafana, Distributed Tracing based on Jaeger, and an ELK-based cloud SIEM. These are fully managed, integrated cloud services that help engineers monitor, troubleshoot, and secure their distributed cloud workloads more effectively. Engineering-driven companies like Siemens, Turner Broadcasting, Unity, and ZipRecruiter use Logz.io to simplify monitoring and security workflows, increase developer productivity, reduce time to resolve issues, and improve the performance and security of their mission-critical applications.
tagline: Leading cloud-native observability platform

description: Speedata was founded by serial entrepreneurs and academic leaders and is funded by top tier VCs. It is developing innovative technology that dramatically accelerates big-data and analytics workloads. Based in Israel, Speedata is a fabless company led by industry leaders with significant experience building successful semiconductor companies.
tagline: Accelerating big data and analytics workloads

description: No system is immune to cyberattacks and IT failures. The main question is how fast you can recover. Salvador Technologies developed the first product in the market that provides full system recovery in just 30 seconds, ensuring the continuous operation of critical workstations and servers worldwide. The patented technology is based on air-gapped protected storage and sophisticated data corruption detection.
tagline: Fast, full recovery from cyberattacks

description: Foursquare is the leading independent location technology platform, powering business solutions and consumer products through a deep understanding of location. Over 1,000 clients—including more than 50% of the Fortune 100—choose Foursquare. The platform empowers brands to measure foot traffic lift via multi-touch attribution; deliver proximity-based advertising; analyze and identify trends; drive deeper engagement through its industry-leading developer tools; and optimize ad campaigns across hundreds of audiences. Foursquare’s R&D team, Foursquare Labs, and its consumer apps round out the portfolio. Over the past 10 years, we’ve counted more than 14 billion consumer-verified place-visit confirmations, which keep our map and models fresh and up-to-date. Foursquare also received the industry's first—and only—accreditation for location data from the Media Rating Council (MRC).
tagline: Leading location technology platform

description: Altesa is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to accelerating the development of new treatments against age-old threats to human health: high-consequence viral pathogens. These threats are particularly severe in the most vulnerable patients, including the chronically ill, the elderly, and the economically disadvantaged. Altesa builds upon a highly successful and proven drug development platform that has already prevented countless deaths from the two greatest pandemics of the past 100 years—HIV and COVID-19.
tagline: Developing treatments for respiratory viruses and global viral threats

description: SURGE seeks to create a world where no one loses a loved one to preventable post-surgical cancer recurrence. The company focuses on concentrating and retaining immunotherapy exactly where and when it’s needed — at the site and time of tumor resection — to help stop recurrence before it starts.
tagline: The Intraoperative Immunotherapy Company™

description: Homethrive is a technology-enabled healthcare services company that reduces work, worry, and stress for unpaid family caregivers, their loved ones, and their employers. Its family caregiving platform, Dari, integrates a digital assistant for coaching, navigation, and resources with expert personal support and service coordination. This combination helps ease the difficult responsibility of caring for loved ones who are aging or have special needs. Caregivers and their families receive the guidance they need to confidently navigate aging, eldercare, and special-needs journeys.
tagline: Caregiver support system

description: Totango powers leading customer-centered enterprises, including Google, NTT, SAP, and Zoom. Its customer success platform brings together customer data, best practices, and key metrics to help teams engage proactively, drive adoption and renewal, expand accounts, and foster long-term advocacy. Totango is headquartered in San Mateo, California, with offices in New York and Tel Aviv.
tagline: Leading customer success platform

description: Venn is the world’s leading end-to-end platform helping multi-family landlords maximize their business by modernizing their resident experience. Combining a powerful property management interface, a resident-facing app, and deep subject matter expertise, Venn's platform gives the real estate industry new tools to build thriving communities and a growing business.
tagline: The resident experience OS

description: Tylko is a next-generation, digital-first furniture company offering premium, customized storage solutions. Founded in 2015 in Warsaw, the company has served nearly 60,000 customers worldwide. Tylko specializes in high-quality, personalized shelving that buyers can customize down to the last detail. Using advanced technology, proprietary software, an intuitive online configurator, and an augmented-reality app, Tylko streamlines the furniture-buying process and delivers functional, beautifully designed pieces that simplify organization at home. With a “buy less, buy better” ethos, Tylko focuses on long-lasting, sustainably made furniture. The company uses responsibly sourced materials and local, resource-efficient production to offer a conscious furniture choice without compromising on quality, style, or durability.
tagline: Digital-first furniture company

description: Knostic addresses oversharing risks in LLMs by creating controls based on individual, need-to-know access. This challenge is especially common when organizations deploy LLM-powered enterprise search tools like Copilot for M365 and leaders discover that the system will answer questions such as “What are people’s salaries?” or “What are the most recent M&A due-diligence results?” This ensures sensitive data stays protected as LLMs scale across the organization.

Duda is the leading professional web design platform for companies that provide web design services to small businesses. The company serves a wide range of customers, from freelance web professionals and digital agencies to major hosting providers, SaaS platforms, and online publishers. With robust collaboration and client-management tools, Duda enables teams to build feature-rich, responsive websites at scale. Every Duda site is automatically optimized for Google Lighthouse and delivers strong out-of-the-box SEO. The company partners with major industry players including GoDaddy, Thryv, Hibu, Italiaonline, 1&1 Ionos, UOL, Sensis, Publicar, Solocal, Telstra, ServiceTitan, and AppFolio. Founded in 2009 by Itai Sadan and Amir Glatt, Duda is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.
tagline: Professional website builder platform

description: Lumigo is building a serverless intelligence platform that helps developers understand and troubleshoot their serverless applications. The platform analyzes large volumes of data, learns the application’s normal behavior, and produces live visual maps and insights that enable developers to identify and fix issues, often before they occur. Founded in 2018 by former Check Point executives, Lumigo is funded by top-tier VCs and is an AWS Advanced Partner.
tagline: Observability for modern cloud apps

description: Browsi is a leading AI-driven SaaS company that empowers publishers and content creators to gain control of their digital real estate. Browsi's AI platform analyzes real-time behavioral data to create personalized ad placements that improve user experience and increase revenue. The company is trusted by premium publishers such as CNN, TMZ, Kobe Shimbun, Reworld Media, and others.
tagline: AI platform that optimizes publishers’ digital real estate

description: Applicaster is a cloud-based platform for app development and content distribution, providing the tools and insights needed to own and engage audiences across all platforms and devices. The platform enables extensive functionality through formal integrations, an open plugin environment, and tools for development and design. Applicaster-powered apps are used by millions of viewers worldwide each day by customers including DirecTV, Fox, ProSiebenSat.1, CONMEBOL, Televisa, TV Azteca, Funke Mediengruppe, WGN America, Hearst, and others. The company serves customers globally with offices in Los Angeles, Miami, New York, London, and Tel Aviv.
tagline: Delivering and managing D2C media applications

description: Unipaas is a Payment-as-a-Service provider that enables SaaS platforms to embed payments and financial services with ease. Through white-label UI components and simple plug-and-play integration, platforms can launch customized payment experiences that drive stronger user adoption and retention. Unipaas supports a broad range of payment methods, including cards, direct debits, and bank transfers, and delivers a fully managed service that streamlines payment collection, compliance, and risk management. Founded in 2020 by fintech experts, Unipaas gives SaaS companies a modern, scalable way to offer embedded payments.
tagline: Embedded payments for SaaS platforms

description: Silk’s Cloud Data Platform helps organizations get more performance and efficiency from their cloud environments. Sitting between the application stack and cloud infrastructure, Silk automatically optimizes data workloads so applications run faster and more cost-effectively. The platform enables higher performance with lower spend, helping enterprises make their cloud deployments smarter, leaner, and more efficient.
tagline: Cost-efficient cloud data platform

description: Medisafe is the leading AI-driven digital patient engagement company, empowering patients to manage their treatment journey and overall health while providing real-time intelligence from billions of data points. By combining advanced technology and a suite of AI-driven solutions with behavioral science, Medisafe supports patients, providers, and payers at scale to improve engagement, health management, and outcomes. More than 13 million registered patients and caregivers rely on Medisafe’s HIPAA- and GDPR-compliant platform, which is also ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 13485 certified.
tagline: AI-driven patient engagement platform

description: CarboFix Orthopedics manufactures advanced implants made from carbon-fiber reinforced polymer (CFR-PEEK), used in spine and long-bone (trauma) surgeries. Their implants combine high mechanical strength with radiolucency and imaging-compatibility, offering advantages for patients needing accurate imaging or radiation-compatible hardware.
tagline: Carbon fiber implants for spine surgery

description: Avantis specializes in creating revenue-generating opportunities for software developers. Since its establishment, the company’s advanced ad technologies have been integrated into numerous web applications and have provided hundreds of developers with effective monetization tools and increased revenue in record time.
tagline: Ad monetization platform for software developers

description: Medinol develops medical devices for the interventional cardiology market, focusing on technologies that support minimally invasive treatment of cardiovascular disease. Pitango’s holdings in Medinol were acquired in a private transaction.
tagline: Cardiovascular intervention technology

description: Zapata AI is the Industrial Generative AI company empowering enterprises to leverage large language models (LLMs) and numerical generative models more effectively and efficiently. The company’s solutions are tailored to domain-specific, industrial-scale business problems to drive growth, savings, and deeper insight. Founded in 2017, Zapata AI is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. Working across both classical and quantum ecosystems, with partnerships that include Amazon, Google, Honeywell, IBM, IonQ, Microsoft, Rigetti, and others, Zapata AI is backed by Ahren Innovation Capital, Alumni Ventures, BASF Venture Capital, Comcast Ventures, The Engine, Honeywell Ventures, Pillar VC, Pitango Ventures, Prelude Ventures, and Robert Bosch Venture Capital.
tagline: The industrial generative AI company

description: Perception Point is a Prevention-as-a-Service company that intercepts content-based attacks across email, cloud storage, CRM applications, and messaging platforms. The platform blocks phishing, BEC, spam, malware, and zero- and N-day exploits before they reach end users. Deployable in minutes with no changes to infrastructure, Perception Point aligns with existing policies and requires minimal effort from IT teams. The company also provides an Incident Response service that acts as a force multiplier for enterprise SOC teams. Its unique technology combines seven detection layers into a single verdict, delivering strong ROI and earning recognition from Gartner. Perception Point now serves global enterprises of all sizes across industries including telecom, food and beverage, technology, healthcare, and more.
tagline: Prevention-as-a-Service company

description: Graphcore makes computing systems that dramatically accelerate artificial intelligence, including its Intelligence Processing Unit (IPU), the most complex microprocessor ever built. The company was founded in 2016 to give innovators a built-for-AI computing technology that would dramatically outperform legacy processors, including GPUs, previously used for machine intelligence. Graphcore's systems are used in financial services, healthcare, consumer internet, scientific research, and many other fields. They also form part of Microsoft’s Azure cloud computing platform. Notable investors include Pitango Venture Capital, Sequoia Capital, BMW iVentures, Microsoft, Samsung, and DeepMind co-founder Demis Hassabis.
tagline: Artificial intelligence processor and systems

description: TScan designs therapies that reprogram a patient's own T cells to recognize and fight their cancer using naturally occurring TCRs that detect shared cancer targets. The TScan discovery process is a proprietary, genome-wide, high-throughput target-identification screen designed to rapidly identify the natural targets of TCRs. TScan is developing a portfolio of TCR therapies for patients with both liquid and solid tumors. The company is funded by leading life science investors including Bessemer Venture Partners, Google Ventures, founding investor Longwood Fund, Novartis Venture Fund, and the Novartis Institutes of Biomedical Research (NIBR).
tagline: T cell target discovery platform

description: Provigent’s cost-effective system-on-a-chip (SoC) products enable wireless system vendors to deliver high-performance broadband wireless systems to network operators. Focused on wireless backhaul and access, Provigent’s SoC solutions provide increased bandwidth, extended range, and enhanced flexibility while lowering overall system costs.
tagline: Wireless backhaul SoC solutions, acquired by Broadcom

description: Scorpio developed advanced networking products for the ATM switch market, delivering high-performance technologies that supported the growing demands of broadband communications in the 1990s. The company was founded by Orni Patraschka and Rafi Gidrom, and its innovative networking solutions led to a full acquisition by U.S. Robotics in 1996.
tagline: Advanced networking products for the ATM switch market, acquired by U.S. Robotics

description: Traiana’s Trading Relationship Management (TRM) solutions integrate counterparties, automate trade processes, and manage trading relationships to lower costs, retain clients, and eliminate operational risk in institutional trading. Its technology became a core part of post-trade workflows across global markets, improving efficiency and reducing operational friction for major financial institutions. Traiana was acquired by ICAP.
tagline: Trading relationship management solutions for institutional markets, acquired by ICAP.

description: VocalTec was a leading supplier of Internet telephony solutions for service providers worldwide. The company provided IP telephony equipment and services, along with Web-enabled call-center and e-commerce communication solutions. VocalTec went public on NASDAQ.
tagline: Pioneer in Internet telephony solutions, went public on NASDAQ

description: Borderfree is a market leader in international cross-border e-commerce solutions, operating a technology and services platform that helps iconic global brands expand into more than 100 countries and transact in over 60 currencies. The company manages all aspects of international online retailing, including localized pricing and payment processing, landed-cost calculation, customs clearance and brokerage, fraud management, logistics orchestration, and customer-experience parity. Borderfree went public on NASDAQ.
tagline: Cross-border e-commerce platform for global brands, went public on NASDAQ

description: Voltaire designed and developed InfiniBand-based connectivity solutions for data centers. Its interconnect technologies powered clusters and grids, enabling high-performance computing on industry-standard servers and storage. Built on InfiniBand infrastructure, Voltaire’s solutions made large-scale grid computing possible by delivering the performance, scalability, and interoperability required for demanding HPC workloads. The company offered a full portfolio of interconnect products, including InfiniBand switches, adapters, InfiniBand-to-IP routers, InfiniBand-to-Fibre Channel routers, and supporting software. For HPC customers, Voltaire provided high-capacity switching and robust, scalable software for the largest clusters and grids. For enterprise environments, Voltaire delivered comprehensive interconnect solutions that integrated seamlessly with leading database and storage applications.
tagline: InfiniBand connectivity solutions for HPC and data centers, went public on NASDAQ

description: Scopus develops digital video networking products, including intelligent video gateways, encoders, decoders and network management products. Scopus developed digital video networking products, including intelligent video gateways, encoders, decoders, and network management systems. Its customers included satellite, cable, and telecom service providers, as well as terrestrial broadcasters, collectively referred to as network operators. Scopus was acquired by Harmonic.
tagline: Digital video networking solutions for operators, acquired by Harmonic

description: Rocket Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: RCKT) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing first-in-class gene therapy treatment options for rare, undertreated diseases. The company uses both lentiviral vector (LVV) and adeno-associated viral vector (AAV) platforms to advance its pipeline. Rocket’s lead clinical program is an LVV-based gene therapy for Fanconi Anemia (FA), a difficult-to-treat genetic disease that causes bone marrow failure and increases cancer risk. Additional preclinical programs target Pyruvate Kinase Deficiency (PKD), Leukocyte Adhesion Deficiency-I (LAD-I), and Infantile Malignant Osteopetrosis (IMO). Rocket is also developing an AAV-based gene therapy program for an undisclosed rare pediatric disease.
tagline: Clinical-stage gene therapy company (NASDAQ: RCKT)

description: Vascular Biogenics (VBL) Ltd. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing first-in-class treatments for cancer and immune-inflammatory diseases. The company’s pipeline is built on two proprietary platforms: the Vascular Targeting System (VTS) for oncology and the Lecinoxoids platform for inflammation. VBL’s lead oncology candidate, VB-111, is a gene-based biologic designed to target and destroy newly formed blood vessels in tumors. VB-111 is initially being developed for recurrent glioblastoma (rGBM) and has received orphan drug designation in the US and Europe, as well as Fast Track designation from the FDA. The company’s anti-inflammatory program centers on its Lecinoxoids platform, a novel class of small molecules that modulate innate immunity. The lead candidate, VB-201, has completed Phase 2 trials in psoriasis and ulcerative colitis.
tagline: Oncology and inflammation gene therapy platforms

description: JinkoSolar Holding Co., Ltd. is one of the world's largest solar panel manufacturers, shipping 11.4 GW of modules in 2018. Headquartered in Shanghai, China, the company began as a wafer manufacturer in 2006 and has since grown into a global leader across the solar value chain. JinkoSolar went public on the New York Stock Exchange.
tagline: Global solar panel manufacturer, NYSE-listed

description: Radware’s Intelligent Traffic Management (ITM) products optimize the end-user experience by eliminating network uncertainty and downtime. The company combines advanced application switching technology with proven traffic management software to ensure continuous availability and high performance for IP-based applications. Radware serves service providers, e-commerce companies, and enterprise customers that require uninterrupted operations. Radware went public on NASDAQ (RDWR).
tagline: Intelligent traffic management solutions, NASDAQ-listed

description: RADLAN provided core networking and routing software IP for component and system-level products. The company’s Networking Reference Software (NRS) was a complete, portable suite that included a packet-classification and routing engine, advanced application-specific features, and web-based management tools. Designed to integrate with any merchant silicon, CPU, or RTOS, NRS enabled datacom and telecom vendors to rapidly develop and release feature-rich systems, giving OEMs a cost-effective embedded networking solution with fast time to market. RADLAN was acquired by Marvell.
tagline: Embedded networking software suite, acquired by Marvell

description: Red Bend was a leading provider of advanced over-the-air (OTA) software management solutions, serving top handset manufacturers and mobile carriers with more than two billion Red Bend-enabled devices worldwide. The company’s technology supported seamless updates for firmware, middleware, third-party applications, and other connected services, helping manufacturers manage increasingly complex device ecosystems. Red Bend was acquired by Harman.
tagline: OTA software management solutions, acquired by Harman

description: superDimension developed minimally invasive pulmonology devices that enable the diagnosis and potential treatment of distal lung disease. The company focused on extending the reach of traditional bronchoscopy tools, allowing physicians to access and diagnose lung lesions that were previously unreachable and to identify disease at earlier, more treatable stages. superDimension was acquired by Covidien.
tagline: Minimally invasive pulmonology devices, acquired by Covidien

description: ConvertMedia developed technology that predicted a user’s likelihood to convert, calculated that user’s value, and purchased ads accordingly to maximize performance. By expanding the available inventory pool for advertisers, the company shifted the supply–demand balance and reduced acquisition costs. Built on advanced algorithms and spatial analysis, ConvertMedia’s Precognitive Ad Targeting (PAT) technology enabled advertisers to use the programmatic ecosystem more effectively for performance-based advertising. ConvertMedia was acquired by Taboola.
tagline: Programmatic ad targeting technology, acquired by Taboola

description: 3DV Systems, Ltd. developed three-dimensional video imaging technology that captured depth information and enabled users to control digital environments through body gestures. The company’s solutions were used in gaming, web conferencing, security, automotive, and robotics applications. 3DV Systems was acquired by Microsoft.
tagline: 3D gesture-control imaging technology, acquired by Microsoft

description: AudioCodes Ltd. (NASDAQ, TASE: AUDC) is a leading provider of advanced voice networking and media-processing solutions for the digital workplace. The company enables enterprises and service providers to build and operate all-IP voice networks for unified communications, contact centers, and hosted business services. AudioCodes’ broad portfolio of products, solutions, and services is used by multinational enterprises and tier-1 operators around the world. AudioCodes was acquired by Active Communications Europe.
tagline: Voice networking and media-processing solutions, acquired by Active Communications Europe

description: BackWeb mobilized critical web applications and content for mobile workforces and remote offices. Its solutions were commonly deployed to sales teams, field employees, mobile managers, and remote operations. Typical use cases included enterprise sales-force automation, CRM, e-learning and training, and human capital management (HCM). BackWeb went public on NASDAQ.
tagline: Mobile workforce application platform, NASDAQ-listed

description: Card Guard, founded in 1986, designed, developed, and marketed telemetric and telediagnostic medical instruments. Its products included EEG devices, a lower-cost alternative to traditional Holter systems for short-term ECG monitoring, telemetry electrodes for real-time heart-rhythm transmission, and devices for detecting ischemia and arrhythmia during cardiac treatment. The company also developed fetal-distress monitoring technology and the Asthma Guard system, which enabled asthma patients to receive remote assessments of lung capacity and symptom severity. Card Guard went public on the Zurich SWX.
tagline: Telemetric and telediagnostic medical devices, listed on Zurich SWX

description: ClearForest Corporation provided text-driven business intelligence solutions that bridged unstructured text and structured enterprise data. By enabling both to be analyzed together, ClearForest helped organizations turn large volumes of contextual information into actionable insights. Its award-winning technology allowed Global 5000 companies to enhance their business intelligence applications by extracting relevant, high-value information from complex content sources. ClearForest’s customers included Kodak, Dow Chemical, Eastman Chemical, NASD, EDS, Boeing, the U.S. Air Force, Reuters, Dow Jones, and Thomson Financial. ClearForest was acquired by Thomson Reuters.
tagline: Text-driven business intelligence platform, acquired by Thomson Reuters

description: ColBar specialized in reconstructive medicine and tissue engineering, focusing on the repair of damaged human tissue including soft tissue, bone, and skin. The company developed a proprietary technique for purifying and transforming collagen to create a range of medical products. ColBar’s technologies supported applications in urology, gastroenterology, orthopedics, and cardiovascular care. ColBar was acquired by Johnson & Johnson.
tagline: Tissue engineering and reconstructive medicine, acquired by Johnson & Johnson

description: Disc-O-Tech Medical Technologies developed expandable implants for minimally invasive orthopedic surgery. The company’s product development team of physicians, engineers, and product managers focused on identifying clinical needs and creating high-quality solutions that improved outcomes for both patients and surgeons. Disc-O-Tech was acquired by Kyphon.
tagline: Expandable implants for minimally invasive orthopedics, acquired by Kyphon

description: GO Networks Inc. developed mobile Wi-Fi network solutions for service providers deploying large-scale campus and municipal wireless systems. Its technology was designed to improve coverage, capacity, and reliability in dense outdoor environments, enabling operators to offer wide-area broadband connectivity with fewer access points and lower deployment costs. GO Networks was acquired by NextWave.
tagline: Mobile Wi-Fi network solutions, acquired by NextWave

description: Gteko developed technology that enhanced and expanded automated and remote technical support capabilities, enabling companies to resolve customer issues more quickly and at scale. Its software automated routine troubleshooting tasks, reduced the need for live support intervention, and helped organizations significantly lower call-center costs while improving service quality. Gteko was acquired by Microsoft.
tagline: Automated remote tech-support software, acquired by Microsoft

description: Optibase was founded as a technology company in the field of digital video. The company went public in March 1999, followed by a secondary offering in March 2000, and has been traded on NASDAQ (OBAS) since.
tagline: Digital video technology company, NASDAQ-listed

description: RADCOM specializes in assuring next-generation, high-capacity networks, including LTE, advanced LTE, 5G, IMS, and SDN/NFV. The company’s Network Intelligence solution provides end-to-end network visibility, from virtual tapping points through to actionable insights, helping operators monitor, optimize, and troubleshoot complex network environments. RADCOM went public on NASDAQ.
tagline: Network intelligence and service assurance, NASDAQ-listed

description: Retalix Ltd. provided integrated software solutions for food and fuel retailers, grocery chains, convenience stores, and foodservice distributors. The company designed, developed, and delivered mission-critical software that connected operations across stores, headquarters, and distribution centers. Its platform enabled retailers and distributors to better understand customers, anticipate demand, enhance the in-store experience, and differentiate their offerings. Retalix’s solutions also supported targeted promotions and loyalty programs through advanced consumer-behavior analytics. Retalix went public on NASDAQ.
tagline: Retail software solutions for food and fuel, NASDAQ-listed

description: Optonol Ltd. developed innovative ophthalmologic devices for the treatment of glaucoma. Founded in 1996 by medical practitioners, engineers, and entrepreneurs, the company focused on advancing minimally invasive solutions for improved patient outcomes. Optonol was acquired by Alcon.
tagline: Glaucoma treatment devices, acquired by Alcon

description: Ubimo’s SaaS platform helps businesses understand and act on real-world consumer behavior, bridging the gap between the digital and physical worlds. Using advanced AI, the platform combines behavioral data from more than 150 million monthly active devices with one of the most comprehensive geographic indexes in the U.S. Ubimo enables organizations to embed strategic, location-based insights into decision-making, improving performance across shopper marketing, programmatic advertising, publishing, retail, and out-of-home media. Ubimo was acquired by Quotient.
tagline: Location intelligence and real-world behavior analytics, acquired by Quotient

description: Timeful used an algorithmic approach to time management, combining big data, behavioral science, and AI to help people prioritize and make time for what matters most. Developed by experts in artificial intelligence, data science, behavioral research, and product design, the Timeful app enabled users to build better habits and manage their schedules more effectively. Timeful was acquired by Google.
tagline: AI-powered time management app, acquired by Google

description: SalesPredict developed technology that helped companies increase revenue by identifying high-potential buyers and providing insights to accelerate sales cycles and improve conversion rates. Its platform combined machine learning, natural language processing, and predictive analytics, drawing on behavioral, firmographic, and demographic data to determine who was ready to buy, who might expand, and who was at risk of churn. SalesPredict was acquired by eBay.
tagline: Predictive sales analytics platform, acquired by eBay

description: Origami Logic developed technology that helped marketing teams understand and improve their performance by showing what was working and what wasn’t. The platform unified and organized large volumes of marketing data across channels and platforms, allowing teams to search, analyze, and act on insights in real time. Global brands such as P&G, HP, JCPenney, Intel, and Omni Hotels relied on Origami Logic to measure impact and optimize their marketing efforts. Origami Logic was acquired by Intuit.
tagline: Marketing performance analytics platform, acquired by Intuit

description: Convergin developed technology that enabled service providers to accelerate their transition to IMS and service delivery platforms (SDP), while seamlessly orchestrating mobile, legacy, next-generation, and web-based services. Convergin was acquired by Oracle.
tagline: Service orchestration for telecom networks, acquired by Oracle

description: Check, launched in 2008, developed a finance app that helped users stay on top of their bills and manage their money automatically. The app earned widespread recognition, including Android Editor’s Choice, Apple’s Best of the Year, CNNMoney’s “Cadillac of Money Management Apps,” and PC Mag’s “100 Best Android Apps.” Check was acquired by Intuit.
tagline: Personal finance and bill-management app, acquired by Intuit

description: MobileAccess developed distributed antenna system (DAS) solutions that provided reliable in-building wireless coverage. The company extended outdoor wireless signals indoors and distributed them through discreet antennas placed throughout a facility, improving coverage and capacity for carriers and enterprises. MobileAccess was acquired by Corning.
tagline: In-building DAS wireless solutions, acquired by Corning

description: Dune Networks was a fabless semiconductor company providing complete solutions for traffic management and non-blocking switching fabric. Its integrated circuits powered the core of Internet and storage platforms, meeting carrier-class requirements for scalability, next-generation services, and high reliability. Dune’s technology was used across enterprise backbones, access and aggregation networks, metro cores, national service provider networks, and high-end storage systems. Dune Networks was acquired by Broadcom.
tagline: Traffic management and switching-fabric semiconductors, acquired by Broadcom

description: Discretix provided embedded security technologies for consumer electronics devices, enabling secure video, payment, and BYOD services. Its products included hardware security co-processors and a broad range of integrated security applications designed to enhance device protection without compromising user experience. Discretix was acquired by ARM.
tagline: Embedded device security solutions, acquired by ARM

description: Cadent developed digital products and services for restorative dentistry and orthodontics, including advanced intra-oral scanners. Its CAD/CAM technology replaced traditional plaster molds, enabling precise adjustments for bridges, implants, and prosthetics, and allowing clinicians to visualize treatment outcomes before procedures. Cadent was acquired by Align Technology.
tagline: Digital intra-oral scanning solutions, acquired by Align Technology

description: dbMotion provided a solution that enabled healthcare organizations to securely share clinical information across different formats, systems, and locations. By unifying patient data from disparate sources, dbMotion helped clinicians make clearer, faster decisions and deliver safer, more coordinated care. dbMotion was acquired by Allscripts.
tagline: Clinical data-sharing platform, acquired by Allscripts

description: AeroScout’s Visibility System used real-time location (RTLS), Active RFID, and telemetry technologies to deliver operational visibility and measurable business benefits. The company pioneered the Wi-Fi visibility market with the industry’s first Wi-Fi–based Active RFID tag and received recognition from leading analysts, industry publications, and awards programs. AeroScout was acquired by Stanley Healthcare.
tagline: Wi-Fi RTLS and Active RFID solutions, acquired by Stanley Healthcare

description: Worklight enabled organizations to efficiently create and run HTML5, hybrid, and native mobile applications for smartphones and tablets using industry-standard technologies and tools. The platform provided a comprehensive and extensible IDE that supported maximum code reuse and per-device optimization, along with mobile middleware, management capabilities, and analytics to support large-scale mobile deployments. Worklight was acquired by IBM.
tagline: Mobile app development platform, acquired by IBM

description: VideoSurf developed an advanced video search engine that helped users search, watch, and discover videos across the web, TV, and mobile devices. Founded in 2006 by experts in search, multi-grid techniques, and computer vision, the company created technology that could visually analyze the content inside videos. By extracting detailed visual information that traditional video sites and search engines could not detect, VideoSurf delivered more relevant results and a significantly improved user experience. VideoSurf was acquired by Microsoft.
tagline: Visual video search technology, acquired by Microsoft

description: SuperDerivatives provided cloud-based, real-time market data, derivatives technology, and valuation services for financial and commodity markets. Its live market data was available both in real time and as end-of-day independent market rates, supporting more accurate pricing, risk management, and transparency for market participants. SuperDerivatives was acquired by Intercontinental Exchange.
tagline: Real-time market data and valuation platform, acquired by ICE

description: Neebula developed Service Availability Management software that improved IT performance and uptime by automatically mapping and managing business services rather than isolated infrastructure components. Built for SaaS delivery, Neebula enabled IT teams to move from siloed monitoring of servers, networks, storage, and applications to a unified view of end-user business services such as CRM, billing, and payments. Its proprietary technology created and continuously maintained a real-time service map across physical, virtual, network, and storage layers, helping organizations focus on what truly impacts the business. This business-aware visibility enhanced event management, accelerated problem isolation, strengthened change control, and delivered clearer service health insights. Neebula was acquired by ServiceNow.
tagline: Automated service availability management, acquired by ServiceNow

description: ImVision protected business applications at Fortune 500 companies from API-related attacks. Its NLP-driven anomaly management platform helped CISOs gain full visibility and control over their APIs by eliminating blind spots from code to production. The platform automatically identified, analyzed, and mitigated potential breaches, enabling organizations to secure APIs at scale.
tagline: API security at scale

description: Signals Analytics powers the future of market intelligence with an AI-driven, configurable data platform that unifies and contextualizes vast external data sources. Its data fabric connects, classifies, and enriches external information to augment analytic applications with exceptional accuracy and scale. Patented machine learning, NLP, and data automation technologies replace traditional data collection and management approaches, enabling organizations to maximize the impact of advanced analytics and unlock the full value of external data. Business users, consumer and market insights teams, and data and analytics organizations rely on the platform to surface trends, generate predictive insights, and integrate business-ready data into their BI environments. Trusted by global brands such as Procter & Gamble, Nestle, Johnson & Johnson, Bayer, Roche, and Mars, Signals Analytics helps companies achieve faster time to insight, stronger data-driven decisions, and more sustainable growth.
tagline: AI-powered external data intelligence

description: ForeScout delivers pervasive network security by enabling organizations to continuously monitor and mitigate security exposures and cyber attacks. The company’s CounterACT appliance dynamically identifies and assesses all network users, endpoints, and applications to provide complete visibility, intelligence, and policy-based mitigation. ForeScout’s open ControlFabric technology integrates with a broad range of IT security products and management systems, allowing them to share information and automate remediation. ForeScout went public on NASDAQ.
tagline: Continuous network security and visibility, went public on NASDAQ

description: Celeno provides high-performance Wi-Fi chips and software for demanding home networking applications. Its chip portfolio and OptimizAIR technology enable reliable, whole-home wireless distribution of multiple simultaneous HD video streams with strong performance and quality of service. Celeno’s field-proven solutions are integrated into a wide range of OEM Wi-Fi devices and deployed by more than 75 service providers worldwide. Founded in 2005, the company has offices across EMEA, the US, and Asia-Pacific, and is backed by investors including Cisco Systems, Greylock IL Partners, Liberty Global, Pitango Venture Capital, and Vintage Investment Partners.
tagline: High performance Wi-Fi chips and software

description: Iguazio provides a data science platform that automates the entire machine learning pipeline, accelerating the development, deployment, and management of AI applications at scale. The platform is open and can be deployed in any environment including multi-cloud, on-prem, or at the edge, allowing data scientists to focus on building accurate, high-impact models rather than managing infrastructure. Iguazio powers real-time data science applications across financial services, gaming, ad-tech, manufacturing, smart mobility, and telecom. Backed by leading financial and strategic investors such as Bosch, Verizon Ventures, Samsung SDS, CME Group, and Dell, the company is led by serial entrepreneurs and a global team across the USA, UK, Singapore, and Israel.
tagline: Bringing data science to life

description: Neura’s Behavioral Intelligence Platform gives organizations real-world behavioral insights that elevate decision making and performance. Brands use Neura to build high-value audiences, enrich their CRM data, and trigger contextual engagements that drive better outcomes. The platform has also supported public health initiatives by helping decision makers monitor and contain the spread of COVID-19 and by enabling predictive test pooling through ViruScoreTM.
tagline: Behavior intelligence platform

description: CyberMDX is a leading medical cybersecurity provider that delivers zero-touch visibility and threat prevention for connected medical devices and clinical assets. Its scalable, easy-to-deploy platform gives hospitals unmatched insight and protection to ensure device uptime, patient safety, and data security. CyberMDX’s multidisciplinary team includes veterans of Israel’s elite cyber units, medical device specialists, and academic leaders in AI.
tagline: Proactive cyber intelligence for medical devices

description: OptimalPlus provided advanced data analytics and real-time quality intelligence solutions for semiconductor and electronics manufacturers, helping global enterprises improve yield, reliability, and product performance. The company was acquired by National Instruments, where its technology continues to support software-connected systems for data-driven engineering and validation.
tagline: Quality intelligence for semiconductor and electronics manufacturing, acquired by NI

description: Anobit developed advanced signal processing technology that significantly improved the cost, performance, and endurance of flash memory devices, enabling next-generation storage solutions. Founded by leading experts in signal processing, digital communications, and silicon design, the company became a key innovator in the global flash market. Acquired by Apple in 2011 and integrated as Apple R&D Israel, the company’s first R&D center outside the United States.
tagline: Flash memory optimization technology

description: Ivy is a community and business management platform built specifically for interior designers. Its intuitive tools help designers run projects, track finances, and manage clients with far less manual work. Created by designers for designers, Ivy replaces spreadsheets and paperwork with a modern workflow that keeps every project organized and every detail in sync.
tagline: Business management platform for interior designers, acquired by Houzz

description: ParallelM provided a fast, reliable path to AI value by automating the deployment, orchestration, and management of machine learning systems in production. ML in production is uniquely challenging due to its non-deterministic, continuously changing behavior, and without proper controls, inaccurate predictions can create significant business risk. ParallelM’s ML Ops Center pioneered the discipline of ML Ops by reducing the time and resources required to deploy and manage ML pipelines, ensuring they scale and perform properly. The platform helped organizations turn ML initiatives into a repeatable, optimized lifecycle, giving Ops teams visibility and control while allowing data scientists to focus on building better models. By combining code instrumentation, distributed data correlation, and ML-driven analytics, ML Ops Center monitored prediction quality in real time and drove corrective action. ParallelM complemented existing ML development tools and analytic engines. Acquired by DataRobot.
tagline: Machine learning operations management, acquired by DataRobot

description: LiveU is a pioneer in broadcast-quality live video transmission over cellular networks, enabling HD and SD video streaming from virtually any location worldwide. Its technology has powered coverage of major breaking news and global events, including the U.S. Presidential Campaign, the London Olympics, Hurricane Sandy, the Royal Wedding, the GRAMMY Awards, and the Super Bowl. LiveU’s solutions combine multiple 4G/3G, HSPA+, WiMAX, and Wi-Fi links to deliver maximum video quality and reliability. A leader in live video over cellular technology, LiveU was acquired by Francisco Partners and Israel Growth Partners.
tagline: Live video transmission over cellular networks, acquired by Francisco Partners & Israel Growth Partners

description: Skycure, acquired by Symantec, provided advanced mobile threat defense that predicted, prevented, and detected cyberattacks across device, network, malware, and vulnerability vectors. Designed to protect without compromising usability or battery life, Skycure enabled organizations to confidently embrace BYOD while maintaining strong security and control. Its dual-layer architecture combined an on-device module with cloud-based analysis to deliver continuous monitoring, intelligent threat response, and zero-downtime protection of critical resources. Skycure supported HIPAA and HITECH compliance and was trusted by numerous Fortune 500 companies.
tagline: Mobile threat defense platform, acquired by Symantec

description: Ventor Technologies developed a valve prosthesis designed for “off-pump” implantation on a beating heart. Its proprietary design enabled easier placement, stronger anchoring, and improved hemodynamic performance. Acquired by Medtronic.
tagline: Off-pump cardiac valve prosthesis, acquired by Medtronic
